name: Ravenheart Hospital
source: RavenHeart Hospital: A Medical Visual Novel is a game where you play as a young prodigal surgeon starting their residency at the world's greatest hospital. Inspired by classic surgery simulation games, romance visual novels, TV medical dramas and anime, you will master a variety of surgery specialties and romance (or befriend) your fellow doctors. Will sparks fly with the fiery paramedic? Will the cowboy surgeon say yeehaw or yee-naw? Is she really going to bring a raven into the OR (and on this date??) Featuring a variety of character stories, surgical operations and support for custom player-made stories, operations and characters, RavenHeart Hospital is your prescription for a good time. Is your heart pumping from a defibrillator or could this be love?
translation: 《RavenHeart Hospital: A Medical Visual Novel》是一款游戏，你将扮演一名年轻的浪子外科医生，开始在世界上最伟大的医院进行住院实习。受到经典手术模拟游戏、浪漫视觉小说、电视医疗剧和动漫的启发，你将掌握各种手术专业，并与你的医生同事谈恋爱（或成为朋友）。火热的护理人员会擦出火花吗？牛仔外科医生会说“yeehaw”还是“yee-naw”？她真的要把一只乌鸦带进手术室吗（而且是在这个日期？） RavenHeart医院以各种角色故事、外科手术以及对自定义玩家制作的故事、手术和角色的支持为特色，是你度过美好时光的处方。你的心脏是通过除颤器跳动的还是这就是爱？
